scripts.build-all: npm run build-decision-all && npm run build-management-all
scripts.build-decision-all: npm run build-decision-csharp && npm run build-decision-java && npm run build-decision-python && npm run build-decision-ruby && npm run build-decision-typescript
scripts.build-decision-typescript: TS_POST_PROCESS_FILE="node ./decision/codegen-config/fix-generated-typescript.js" npx @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate --input-spec ./decision/openapi-3.yaml --generator-name typescript-fetch --output ./.build/ts/decision --config ./decision/codegen-config/typescript-fetch.json && npm run typecheck-decision-typescript
scripts.typecheck-decision-typescript: cd .build/ts/decision && tsc --outDir dist --declaration --target es5 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --lib es6,dom *.ts
scripts.build-management-all: npm run build-management-csharp && npm run build-management-ruby && npm run build-management-typescript
scripts.typecheck-management-typescript: cd .build/ts/management && tsc --outDir dist --declaration --target es5 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --lib es6,dom *.ts
scripts.validate-all: npm run validate-decision && npm run validate-management && npm run validate-user-content-db
scripts.validate-and-build-all: npm run validate-all && npm run build-all
scripts.validate-management:
for f in management/*.yaml; do echo "
== $f =="; npx @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli validate -i "$f" || status=1; done; exit ${status:-0}
